<query>www.home.fedex.com/express FedEx express shipping</query>

The URL **www.home.fedex.com/express** appears to be an older or alternate FedEx domain structure. Currently, FedEx's main website for express shipping services is located at **www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html** or simply **www.fedex.com**.

**What you can typically do on FedEx Express pages:**
- Ship packages domestically and internationally
- Get rate quotes and transit times
- Schedule pickups
- Track shipments
- Find drop-off locations
- Access shipping tools and resources
- Manage your account

**FedEx Express service options include:**
- FedEx First Overnight
- FedEx Priority Overnight
- FedEx Standard Overnight
- FedEx 2Day
- FedEx Express Saver
- FedEx International services

If you're trying to access this specific URL and it's not working, I'd recommend:
1. Trying **https://www.fedex.com** directly
2. Navigating to their express shipping page from the main site
3. Checking if you have the correct URL (the "home" subdomain may be outdated)
